question: Sri Lanka is separated from India by a narrow channel of sea, formed by _______ and the Gulf of Mannar.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Palk Strait**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sri Lanka is separated from India by a narrow channel of sea formed by The Palk Strait and the Gulf of Mannar.
 
• The Palk Strait connects India (Tamil Nadu) with Sri Lanka (Jaffna).
 
• The Mannar Gulf is located near Mannar Island in Sri Lanka.
 
• Adam's Bridge (Rama Setu), which is 50 kilometers long, connects the Palk Strait with the Gulf of Mannar.
 
• The Gulf of Mannar is a huge shallow harbor in the Indian Ocean that is part of the Laccadive Sea.
 
• The Coromandel Coast region is located between the southeastern tip of India and the west coast of Sri Lanka.
